fact: Mmegi reports Parliament launched BW Speaks, an online platform for citizens to voice issues to MPs and be responded to, on 28 July 2022.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that it has a platform for citizens to give feedback on service delivery, naming botswanaspeaks.gov.bw; no launch date or case count is given, so the as_of is the survey round's year.
